καλέσσαι: καλέω — call, summon; aor. inf. act., epic doubled σσ (= Attic καλέσαι)
κατάβηθι: καταβαίνω — go down, descend; aor. imper. 2 sg., ending -θι (= Attic κατάβηθι)

κραταίπεδον: κραταίπεδος — hard-floored, with firm ground; neut. acc. sg., epithet of οὖδας ’ground’

λέκτροιο: λέκτρον — bed, couch; neut. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
λωβεύεις: λωβεύω — mock, make sport of, abuse; pres. 2 sg.
λωβεύω: λωβεύω — mock, make sport of, abuse; pres. 1 sg.
μάργην: μάργος — mad, frenzied, senseless; fem. acc. sg., predicate with σε: ’mad’
παρστᾶσα: παρίστημι — stand beside; aor. part. fem. nom. sg., syncopated (= Attic παραστᾶσα)

περικαλλές: περικαλλής — very fair, exceedingly beautiful; neut. nom./acc. sg., agreeing with δῶμα
περιπλέχθη: περιπλέκω — twine round, embrace; aor. pass. 3 sg. with dat., middle sense: ’clung to’
πολυπενθέα: πολυπενθής — much-grieving, full of sorrow; masc. acc. sg., epic -έα (= Attic -ῆ), with θυμόν
πολυϊδρείῃσι: πολυϊδρείη — great knowledge, cunning, skill; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αις), of cause
πολύϊδριν: πολύϊδρις — very knowing, shrewd; fem. acc. sg., agreeing with ἐοῦσαν
σαοφροσύνης: σαοφροσύνη — soundness of mind, prudence; fem. gen. sg., epic σαο- (= Attic σωφροσύνης)
σαοφροσύνῃσι: σαοφροσύνη — soundness of mind, prudence; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic σωφροσύναις), of means
στόνον: στόνος — groan, groaning; masc. acc. sg.
τίεσκον: τίω — honour, esteem; impf. 3 pl. (same form 1 sg.), iterative -σκον, unaugmented: ’used to honour’
τεθνηότας: θνῄσκω — die; perf. part. masc. acc. pl., epic τεθνηότ- (= Attic τεθνεῶτας): ’dead’
τεκόμεσθα: τίκτω — beget, bear; aor. 1 pl. mid., epic ending -μεσθα, unaugmented (= Attic ἐτεκόμεθα)
τοίχου: τοῖχος — wall (of a house or room); masc. gen. sg.
φανείη: φαίνω — show; pass. appear; aor. pass. opt. 3 sg.: ’would appear’
φρασάμην: φράζω — point out; mid. notice, take note of; aor. 1 sg. mid.
χαλιφρονέοντα: χαλιφρονέω — be light-minded, thoughtless; pres. part. masc. acc. sg., epic uncontracted -έοντα (= Attic -οῦντα)
ἀγασσάμενος: ἄγαμαι — wonder at; take offence at, resent; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., epic σσ (= Attic ἀγασάμενος)

ἀπονίζουσα: ἀπονίζω — wash off, wash; pres. part. fem. nom. sg.
ἀσπαστὸς: ἀσπαστός — welcome, gladly greeted; masc. nom. sg., predicate
ἀτίμων: ἀτιμάω — dishonour, treat with contempt; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented, contracted (= Attic ἠτίμων)
ἀτασθαλίας: ἀτασθαλία — reckless wickedness, wanton folly; fem. acc. pl. (also gen. sg.), after διά: ’through’
ἀτυζόμεναι: ἀτύζομαι — be scared, be dazed with fear; pres. part. mid./pass. fem. nom. pl.

ἐλθοῦσ: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. part. fem. nom. sg., elided (ἐλθοῦσ’ = ἐλθοῦσα)
ἐνωπαδίως: ἐνωπαδίως — face to face, openly; adv.

ἐξερεείνοι: ἐξερεείνω — question closely, inquire of; pres. opt. 3 sg., epic form of ἐρεείνω, in a deliberation: ’should she question’
ἐπέβησαν: ἐπιβαίνω — step upon; aor. act. (weak) causative: set upon, bring to (+ gen.); 3 pl.
ἐπίφρονά: ἐπίφρων — thoughtful, prudent, sensible; masc. acc. sg., accented ἐπίφρονά before the enclitic περ
ἐπεύχεο: ἐπεύχομαι — boast over, vaunt, pray; pres. imper. 2 sg., epic -εο (= Attic ἐπεύχου)

ἐρέουσα: ἐρέω (fut. of εἶπον) — say, tell; fut. part. fem. nom. sg., epic open -έουσα (= Attic ἐροῦσα)
ἐρρώσαντο: ῥώομαι — move with vigour, dart, rush; aor. 3 pl. mid. (of the knees): ’moved briskly’

ἐϋφροσύνης: εὐφροσύνη — good cheer, joy, mirth; fem. gen. sg., epic ἐϋ- (= Attic εὐ-), after ἐπιβῆτον

ἔβλαψαν: βλάπτω — harm, hinder, damage; aor. 3 pl.
ἔδον: ἔδω — eat; impf. 3 pl., epic (= Attic ἤσθιον): ’ate’
ἔκευθεν: κεύθω — hide, conceal; impf. 3 sg., epic/poetic: ’hid’
ἔκτεινεν: κτείνω — kill, slay; aor. 3 sg., augmented (ν-movable)

ἰδοῦσά: ὁράω — see; aor. part. fem. nom. sg. (aor. stem ἰδ-), accented ἰδοῦσά before the enclitic κε
ἱκάνεται: ἱκάνω — come to, arrive at, reach; pres. 3 sg. mid. (deponent), epic (= Attic ἀφικνεῖται)

ὀψέ: ὀψέ — late, at a late hour; adv.
ὑπερικταίνοντο: ὑπερικταίνομαι — meaning unknown, a hapax (occurs once in Greek); perhaps ’were quickened, stirred’ by the context only; impf. 3 pl. mid.

__broaden__.κακὸν: κακός — bad, evil; masc./neut. acc. sg.: ’by an evil (fate)’, inner acc. with μόρον · also neut. nom. sg., subject of an impersonal verb (τι … κακὸν … μελέτω ’let no evil thing be a care’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a plain substantive, direct object: ’harm, evil’ (κακὸν ἀλλοδαποῖσι φέροντες ’bringing harm to men of other lands’) · also neut. acc. sg., attributive with ἦμαρ: ’evil’ (κακὸν ἦμαρ ’the evil day’) · also masc. acc. sg., predicative: ’base, cowardly’ (κακὸν καὶ ἀνήνορα ’base and unmanned’) · also neut. acc. sg. attributive with πῆμα: ’evil’ (πῆμα κακὸν ’evil harm’) · also neut. nom. sg., predicate with an infinitive as subject: κακὸν … βάζειν ’(it is) bad to speak’ · also neut. acc. sg. governed by ἐς: ’into evil’ (ἐς κακὸν … βάλῃσθα) · also neut. acc. sg. subject of an infinitive: ’an evil’ (κακὸν ἔμμεναι ’that an evil is’) · also neut. nom. sg., subject of εἴη: ’evil’ (μή τι κακὸν … εἴη ’and may no evil be’) · also neut. acc. sg., attributive with ῥάκος: ’vile’ (ῥάκος ἄλλο κακὸν ’another, a vile rag’) · also neut. nom. sg., subject of a finite verb: ’an evil’ (ἐπεὶ κακὸν ἔμπεσεν οἴκῳ ’since an evil fell upon the house’) · also neut. nom. sg., predicate with γενοίμην: ’a bane, an evil (to them)’ · also masc. acc. sg. as a plain substantive, direct object: ’a base man’ (κακὸς κακὸν ἡγηλάζει) · also masc. acc. sg., attributive with θάνατον: ’evil’ (θάνατον … κακόν ’evil death’) · also masc. acc. sg., in apposition to τινα: ’bad (man)’ (οὐ κακὸν οὐδὲ … ἐσθλόν ’neither bad nor good’)
__broaden__.μακρὸν: μακρός — long, far; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’far, loudly’ · also masc. acc. sg. agreeing with a noun: ’tall’ (κίονα μακρὸν ’a tall pillar’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with ἐέλδωρ: ’long’ (μακρὸν ἐέλδωρ ’long wish’)
__broaden__.τί: τίς, τί — who? what?; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially ’why’ · also the enclitic indefinite τις, τι ’someone, something’ (accented τί before an enclitic): neut. acc. sg. used adverbially with a negative, ’at all’ (οὔ τι) · adj. · also plain interrogative, direct object/predicate: ’what’ (τί πάθω ’what am I to suffer’; τί ... γένηται ’what is to become’) · also the enclitic indefinite as an adjective agreeing with a noun, accented before enclitic που: εἴ τί που εἴλυμα ’if any wrapper’ · also enclitic indefinite with a negative, ’anything’, as accusative subject of an infinitive (οὐ … τί φημι κακώτερον ἄλλο … συγχεῦαι ’I say nothing else is worse’) · also enclitic indefinite, adverbial without a negative: ’somehow, in some way’ (τοῦτό τί μοι κάλλιστον ’this seems to me somehow the fairest’) · also enclitic indefinite as an adjective after μή, accented before an enclitic: ’any’ (μή τί τοι … πῆμα ’any harm to you’) · also enclitic indefinite adjective after ὅπως, accented before enclitic μοι: ’any’ (τί … ἄλγος ’any pain’) · also enclitic indefinite adjective after ἤ, accented before the enclitic μοι: ’any’ (ἤ τί μοι … κειμήλιον ’or any treasure of mine’) · also the enclitic indefinite as a substantive object after εἴ: ’anything’ (εἴ τί μιν εἴποι ’whether she would say anything to him’)
__broaden__.εἰσαφίκοιτο: εἰσαφικνέομαι — arrive at, come to; aor. opt. 3 sg. mid., potential with κεν: ’would reach’ · also aor. opt. 3 sg. in a past general relative clause, no κεν: ’whoever came to’ (ὅτις σφέας εἰσαφίκοιτο)
__broaden__.ἔα: ἐάω — let be, allow, leave alone; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’leave alone!’ · also εἰμί — be; impf. 1 sg., epic (= Attic ἦν): ’I was’ (τοῖος ἔα ’such I was’) · also ἐάω — allow; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= εἴα): ’allowed’ (οὐκ ἔα ’did not allow’)
__broaden__.ὄψει: ὁράω — see; fut. 2 sg. mid., epic -ει (= Attic ὄψῃ) · also ὄψις — sight, the eyes; fem. dat. sg., instrumental: ’with the eyes’ (ὄψει … ἐσίδεσκεν ’looked with her eyes’)
